learningGoals: Recall the precise Year 8 vocabulary for balanced diet and nutrients.
Apply the knowledge rather than relying on recognition alone.

mustMemoriseRules: Seven components: carbohydrate, protein, lipid, fibre, vitamins, minerals and water.

Starch becomes simple sugars, protein becomes amino acids, and lipid becomes fatty acids plus glycerol.
